visual.description: Left half is a solid amber/yellow background with brand name top-left, logo top-right, and large bold headline with orange accent word at center-left; right half is dark near-black with a stacked interactive panel spelling M-U-B-A-S-I-C vertically using colored horizontal rows (teal, black, amber, cream, black/orange, purple), each row containing a letter tile offset to suggest depth or interactivity.

Left column is a light gray background with a vertical list of music categories (Quirky highlighted in teal, Sleep, Characters, Movement, Holidays & Celebrations, Party & Playtime), each with an icon; right column is divided into two quadrants — upper-left teal with a character icon, upper-right orange with a play button circle, lower spanning amber/orange with a horizontal barcode-style waveform graphic and filename label.

Left column has a warm beige background with oversized bold black headline spanning multiple lines; right column has a 2×2 photo grid showing four portrait-cropped musician photos (Producers, Musicians, Visual Artists, Vocalists), each with a colored background tile (teal, amber, purple, orange).

Left column continues warm beige with a secondary smaller body text below the headline; right column shows the lower two portrait cards (Visual Artists on teal, Vocalists on amber) continuing the 2×2 grid from above.

Left column is solid near-black with no content visible (empty dark panel); right column is off-white/light gray with a very large bold black statement headline ('Our music is already playing, practically everywhere.') taking up most of the space.

Left column shows a horizontal row of circular streaming platform logos (Tidal, Amazon Music, Shazam, YouTube) on a near-black background; right column continues the body copy on white describing collaborations.

Left column has a light gray background with a vertical accordion list of FAQ questions (first item highlighted in dark with purple text); right column has a solid lavender/purple background showing 'Answer' label at top and a large bold body answer text below.

Left column has a warm peach/sand background with a cut-out style photo of a girl with headphones placed over an orange rounded rectangle shape; right column has a slightly warmer beige background with a large bold black headline ('Driven by the desire to enable better music for children.') and body copy below.

Left column is solid amber/yellow with a bold multi-line headline where the word 'good' is in orange; right column is off-white/light gray with a vertical stacked contact form (Name, Email Address, Message fields) and an orange 'Send' CTA button at bottom-right.

Upper section splits 50/50 — left is lavender with 'Contact us anytime' and email address, right is tan/wheat with 'follow us anywhere' and social icon row; below that is a full-width dark panel with Spotify logo, large 'Listen to us all the time' headline, a Spotify text link, and a portrait photo of a person with headphones on a teal-cornered card; footer below is full-width cream/off-white with horizontal navigation links and giant 'mubasic' wordmark at very large scale bleeding off both edges.
